fires.name: pipe at the end of the line
pipe at the start of the next line
set -o errexit -o pipefail
fires.text:
set -o errexit -o pipefail
foo | grep -q bar

fires.name: inside a command substitution
fires.text:
set -uo pipefail
x="$(foo | grep -q bar && echo yes)"

fires.name: flag after a quoted pattern holding a pipe
workflow run block under set pipefail
fires.text:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - name: probe
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          curl -fsSI "$SITE/" | tr -d '\r' | grep -qi "^$h:" && echo ok

fires.name: workflow step pinned to shell: bash
fires.text:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - name: probe
        shell: bash
        run: foo | grep -q bar

fires.name: workflow dash-run block
fires.text:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - run: |
          set -o pipefail
          foo | grep -q bar

clean.name: grep without -q
clean.text:
set -euo pipefail
foo | grep bar | sort

clean.name: or, not a pipe
clean.text:
set -euo pipefail
foo || grep -q bar file

clean.name: q only inside the quoted pattern
workflow block without pipefail
clean.text:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - run: |
          set -e
          foo | grep -q bar

clean.name: pipefail in a different run block
clean.text:
jobs:
  a:
    steps:
      - run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo hi
      - run: foo | grep -q bar
